connector.name: Govee
connector.registryDescription: LAN-first, cloud-fallback MCP server for Govee smart lights and devices.
connector.summary: Runs locally from the Python package govee-mcp. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the evefromwayback account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.

env.name: GOVEE_API_KEY
env.description: Govee Developer API key (Govee Home app: Profile > About Us > Apply for API Key). Needed for cloud control and non-LAN devices; LAN-only works without it.
